images.author: Francesco Ungaro
images.why: Source identifies a wild polar bear crossing Arctic terrain; 6240 × 4160 with camera metadata. Strong resolution for a 9:10 crop.

images.author: Putulik Jaaka
images.why: Source identifies a solitary polar bear in snowy Arctic wilderness; 8064 × 4536. Ample pixels for cropping, though the original composition is wide.

images.author: Jenny Wong
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies a male polar bear walking on a frozen pond near Churchill, Manitoba. Full animal in blue ice and snowy tundra; dimensions unverified.

images.author: Matt Meisenheimer
images.why: Photographer documents wild polar-bear encounters around Svalbard. Walking bear on sea ice provides the classic Arctic setting; dimensions unverified.

images.author: Paal Uglefisk Lund
images.why: Photographer confirms a wild Svalbard encounter. Whole bear and reflection make a striking near-square composition; blood on the muzzle is visible. Dimensions unverified.

images.author: Francesco Ungaro
images.why: Source explicitly identifies Ursus maritimus roaming a wild Arctic shoreline. Useful rocky-coast alternative to snow; original download linked, dimensions unverified.

images.author: Sergio Pérez Mateo
images.why: Caption confirms a polar bear on Svalbard. Resting pose offers a quieter alternative; 3000-pixel delivery requested, native dimensions unverified.

images.author: Daniela A Nievergelt
images.why: Caption explicitly confirms a large male polar bear on Storøya, Svalbard. Lower-resolution fallback: linked Flickr size is at most 1024 pixels; seek the original for production.

images.author: Mogens Trolle
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies a Grévy’s zebra stallion at Buffalo Springs, Kenya. Solitary adult, warm grassland colours and clear species markings; dimensions unverified.

images.author: Mogens Trolle
images.why: Separate photograph captioned Grévy’s zebra stallion, Buffalo Springs. Profile view against golden grass emphasizes dense stripes and erect mane; dimensions unverified.

images.author: Untamed Photo Safaris; individual photographer uncredited
images.why: Image caption explicitly identifies a Grévy’s zebra standing in Samburu’s grassland. Single subject and soft background suit a poster crop; original asset dimensions unverified.

images.author: Cebulek Photography
images.why: Individual photo page identifies Equus grevyi and places it in Samburu. Two animals in dry natural habitat, with characteristic narrow stripes and large ears; dimensions unverified.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Conservation organization labels the photograph Grévy zebra in its Samburu trip listing. Solitary full-body animal, open savanna and blue sky; dimensions unverified.

images.author: Kathy Karn
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies a group of Grévy’s zebras in Lewa Wildlife Conservancy, Kenya. Wild-habitat group alternative; distinguish this image from the article’s plains-zebra comparisons. Dimensions unverified.

images.author: Steve Turner
images.why: Caption identifies Grévy’s zebras in Samburu. Adult mare with foal on warm red earth provides full-body wildlife context; dimensions unverified.

images.author: Mogens Trolle
images.why: Caption explicitly confirms Grévy’s zebra in Samburu. Strong portrait alternative highlighting large rounded ears and fine facial stripes; not full-body. Dimensions unverified.
